title: yticklabels
summary: Query or set Y-axis tick labels for the current axes or a specified axes handle.
description: `yticklabels` controls the display text associated with Y-axis tick marks. It supports query, explicit label assignment, automatic mode, manual mode, mode query, and explicit axes-target forms.

arguments.name: labels
arguments.type: cell array of character vectors | string array | char array | []
arguments.description: Labels to associate with the current Y-axis ticks. Fewer labels than ticks are padded with empty character vectors; an empty cell or empty numeric array removes labels.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: 'auto' returns tick labels to automatic generation, 'manual' freezes current labels, and 'mode' queries the current label mode.

arguments.name: ax
arguments.description: Target axes handle. If omitted, the current axes are used.

examples.description: Set Y-axis tick values and labels
examples.output: % The Y-axis shows the three supplied labels

ans = 'manual'
% Labels return to automatic numeric formatting

examples.description: Set labels on a specific axes
examples.output: % Only the target axes receives the labels

notes: Setting explicit labels also freezes the Y tick values at their current positions, matching MATLAB's YTickMode side effect.
Automatic labels are formatted from the current Y tick values and cached display bounds, so this builtin does not gather plot data from accelerated backends.
gpu_residency: `yticklabels` only reads and writes axes metadata. It does not gather GPU-resident plot data; automatic labels are generated from current tick metadata and cached display bounds.
